abstract: Benchmark LLM serving with NVIDIA AIPerf against OpenAI-compatible endpoints: pinned install, aiperf profile flags and YAML configs, synthetic and trace workloads, metric definitions (TTFT, ITL, throughput, goodput), concurrency and request-rate sweeps, multi-run confidence intervals, GPU telemetry and server metrics, and GenAI-Perf migration. References split by install, CLI, workloads and metrics, sweeps, a vLLM combo, troubleshooting and updating.
